fields.v: No limitations of the paper stated. Limitations of SDD discussed: LLM non-determinism; over-specification, specification rot, spec as bureaucracy, tooling complexity, false confidence (passing spec test does not guarantee correct software); SDD overkill for throwaway prototypes, solo short-lived projects, exploratory coding, simple CRUD; spec-as-source practical only where generation trust is established
